recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future work needs enforceable common IG page headings or menus, handle it in the IG Publisher/template/tooling project or other current IG-governance artifacts, not by editing the current core FHIR source solely for this old DSTU1 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-8008 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification FMG change request from the 2015 May ballot. It observed that each implementation-guide subpage had its own layout and asked that, before final DSTU publication, IG subpages have a small set of common headings. The accepted resolution was to solicit feedback about IG organization/content/formatting, apply that learning to some IGs, and then produce broader IG guidance rather than impose an immediate DSTU2 source change.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-8008 source commit was found. The nearby source history shows broader IG infrastructure work in 2015 and a 2016 removal/commenting-out of many old in-core implementation-guide entries. In the current checkout, source/iglist.html and source/guides/ are absent, source/igs.xml is only the metadata list for remaining core IG/package entries, and source/fhir.ini only has an additional external IG-list entry plus the normal ImplementationGuide resource build entry.
additional_context: FMG revisited the tracker in 2021 and recorded that IG templates had addressed part of the issue and that the FHIR-I project on IG templates and tooling covered more of it, with no further action needed from FMG. Exact Zulip searches for the issue key, old tracker number, and common-heading phrase did not reveal a conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Editing current core FHIR source would not implement the old request because the old IG subpage layout sources are gone/out of build scope, and the remaining issue belongs to IG template/tooling governance rather than the core specification source.
